reasoning: As of October 16, 2025, Tesla needs to achieve 10,000 driverless ride-hailing rides in the US by year-end (76 days remaining). Elon Musk stated in early 2025 that driverless ride-hailing would launch in Austin by June. However, there's no public evidence that Tesla has launched a commercial driverless ride-hailing service meeting the strict criteria (completely autonomous, no human backup, genuine rides >400m, no testers, no Smart Summon). Tesla's autonomous capabilities remain limited compared to Waymo. The ambitious timeline, technical challenges, regulatory hurdles, and lack of confirmed launch make reaching 10,000 rides by year-end highly unlikely. Even if launched soon, scaling to 10,000 rides in 2.5 months would require rapid deployment and adoption.
